name: Margherita Classic Pizza
description: Stone-baked crust topped with rich San Marzano tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella pearls, and fragrant basil leaves.

name: Spicy Pepperoni Feast
description: Crispy artisanal crust smothered with melted mozzarella, spicy Italian pepperoni slices, and crushed red chili flakes.

name: Truffle Mushroom Pizza
description: White garlic cream sauce topped with wild forest mushrooms, fontina cheese, thyme, and a drizzle of aromatic truffle oil.

name: Classic Gourmet Cheeseburger
description: Charbroiled 100% Angus beef patty topped with aged cheddar, crisp butter lettuce, ripe tomato, and house burger sauce on a brioche bun.

name: Smoky BBQ Bacon Burger
description: Juicy grilled beef patty layered with thick-cut smoked bacon, crispy onion rings, sharp cheddar, and tangy honey BBQ sauce.

name: Crispy Garden Veggie Burger
description: Golden quinoa and black bean patty, avocado crema, pickled red onions, fresh baby spinach, and vegan chipotle mayo.

name: Creamy Fettuccine Alfredo
description: Al dente fettuccine ribbons tossed in a velvety sauce of pure sweet butter, heavy cream, garlic, and freshly grated Parmigiano-Reggiano.

name: Penne Arrabbiata Piccante
description: Classic penne pasta simmered in a spicy, fiery tomato sauce with extra virgin olive oil, garlic, and fresh Italian parsley.

name: Slow-Braised Bolognese Tagliatelle
description: Hearty slow-cooked beef and pork ragù infused with Chianti wine, rosemary, and root vegetables over fresh golden egg tagliatelle.

name: Iced Berry Lemonade Cooler
description: Refreshing freshly squeezed lemons infused with crushed wild raspberries, fresh mint leaves, and sparkling spring water.

name: Creamy Caramel Cold Brew
description: Smooth 18-hour steeped cold brew coffee poured over artisan ice, layered with oat milk and rich salted caramel syrup.

name: Warm Molten Chocolate Lava Cake
description: Decadent dark Belgian chocolate cake with a molten liquid center, served with powdered sugar and premium vanilla bean cream.
